title: Caregivers pay for care with waiting time
discussion_signal: The post describes waiting for appointments, callbacks, test results, and prescriptions as a hidden caregiving burden that forces missed work, rearranged schedules, and uncertainty. Replies describe waiting as a loss of usable time rather than merely idle time.
linked_research_question: How waiting and care coordination move time costs onto caregivers and affect work, family routines, and capacity to continue caring.
engagement: 48 visible comments in the indexed result; visibility is not prevalence or agreement.
limits: Professional and caregiver audience is selected
Self-reported experiences are not time diaries or administrative records
The post is not a representative sample of caregivers
